feeds.title: On Firmer Ground
feeds.description: This blog serves as a space for legal information professionals to share best practices, explore innovative solutions, and focus on how to best contribute to the effective operation of law firms. The mission of On Firmer Ground is to promote the value that law firm librarians bring to the business and practice of law by providing an online forum for law librarians to share how they are providing innovative practice support, leveraging technology to provide process efficiencies that allow lawyers and support staff to work smarter

feeds.title: FCIL-SIS
feeds.description: The FCIL-SIS serves as a forum for the exchange of ideas and information on foreign, comparative, and international law and legal research. This blog is intended to be a fun and educational resource for FCIL-SIS members, other law librarians, and anyone interested in foreign, comparative, and international law or law librarianship.

feeds.title: TSLL TechScans
feeds.description: A Blog to share the latest trends and technology tools for Technical Services Law Librarians. Technical Services Law Librarian (TSLL) is an official publication of the Technical Services Special Interest Section (TS-SIS) and the Library Systems & Resource Discovery Special Interest Section (LSRD-SIS) of the American Association of Law Libraries (AALL).

feeds.title: CT Judicial Law Libraries' NewsLog
feeds.description: This is the official news log website for the Law Libraries of the State of Connecticut Judicial Branch which helps you stay informed about recent legal developments, legal practice tools, and law library resources in Connecticut. The mission of the Connecticut Judicial Branch is to serve the interests of justice and the public by resolving matters brought before it in a fair, timely, efficient, and open manner.

feeds.title: Criminal Law Library Blog
feeds.description: Criminal Law Library Blog is published by New York principal Law Librarian retired David Badertscher. One can find articles, news, and stories on topics like criminal law and justice, Court Decisions, library organization and planning, and more.

feeds.title: Boston College Legal Eagle
feeds.description: News & research updates from the legal information librarians at BC Law School. The library's collections and services are focused on supporting the law school curriculum and the research needs of B.C. Law students and faculty.

feeds.title: The Law Bod Blog
feeds.description: Bodleian Law Library occasionally picks up news or information or ideas that are worth sharing, and we plan to use Law Bod Blog for this purpose. We are a group of librarians/ information specialists/reference assistants/ research assistants and others who work together in this wonderful library which holds one of the best collections of law-related resources in the UK.

feeds.title: Hamilton County Law Library Blog
feeds.description: Hamilton County Law Library Blog features articles on the judiciary, legal matters, legal research, talks by attorneys, and more. The Hamilton County Law Library fulfills its statutory duties and serves by providing professional, practical legal research services, relevant information, and education to the public. Tradition is well represented by archival and historical materials.

feeds.title: BLS Library Blog
feeds.description: Brooklyn Law School librarians have blogged about topical legal issues, recent legislation and court decisions, and legal trends. We also write about BLS Library events, legal writing and research, and online legal resources. While most posts are written by librarians, we welcome student contributions.

feeds.title: Wisblawg
feeds.description: WisBlawg is a legal blog by the University of Wisconsin Law Library that offers legal research news and information emphasizing Wisconsin. Created and authored by Bonnie Shusha, WisBlawg is one of the earliest legal blogs and shares the research expertise of UW Law Librarians with the legal and broader community. It reaches thousands of readers including librarians, legal practitioners, judges, and many others.

feeds.title: Law Librarians of New England Blog
feeds.description: Law Librarians of New England was organized in 1946. The Association is organized to promote the profession of law librarianship, and more particularly, to enhance the roles of law librarians in the legal and library professions, to provide for the further professional education of law librarians, to establish a continuing relationship between law librarians and legal entities in New England, and to foster a spirit of cooperation among the members of the profession.

feeds.title: Dewey B Strategic
feeds.description: Dewey B Strategic was created by Editor and Author Jean P. O'Grady in 2011. She launched 'Dewey B Strategic' to promote awareness of the strategic importance of librarians, libraries, and knowledge managers as change agents and innovators in the organizations they support. She is a frequent author and speaker on the transformation of libraries and information centers, digital contract licensing, knowledge management, and the legal publishing industry.

feeds.title: Hunter's Query
feeds.description: The Library blog from Brigham Young University's J. Reuben Clark Law School. They provide news, articles, and updates related to law, judiciary, and more for the attorneys, patrons, and law students. As it makes advances in areas such as corpus linguistics, criminal justice, and religious freedom, the law school advances its commitment to empowering individuals and communities through the rule of law.

feeds.title: CSU Law Library Blog
feeds.description: In support of the mission of the Cleveland-Marshall College of Law, the Law Library's mission is the provision of information services and resources that promote the performance of high-quality legal research activities by our students, faculty, staff, and community. One can find articles on topics related to Bar Exam, Criminal law, Sports Law, Tax Law, and more.

feeds.title: Daniel F. Cracchiolo Law Library Blog
feeds.description: We provide open and equitable access to credible sources of news, data, and knowledge on subjects related to law, American Indian Studies, Gender Studies, Women's Studies, and more. The Daniel F. Cracchiolo Law Library advocates for policies, laws, and practices that champion intellectual freedom, privacy, confidentiality, rigorous research, antiracism, and equitable access to information.

feeds.title: The Goodson Blogson
feeds.description: The Goodson Blogson provides news & announcements from the J. Michael Goodson Law Library at Duke. The blog features articles on Bloomberg law, Proquest supreme court insights, Crime and punishment resources, and more.

feeds.title: The Blackacre Times
feeds.description: The Blackacre Times is produced by the Georgia State University Law Library. It features library news and announcements as well as helpful tips and brief descriptions of resources law students, attorneys, and other patrons might find useful in their research. The Georgia State University College of Law Library provides patrons with comfortable research and study areas in a wireless and wired environment.

feeds.title: Penn Carrey Law » Library Blog
feeds.description: Read news, stories, and articles on the Law Library, an exhibition on law history, and more in the following segment of Penn Law Blog. The University of Pennsylvania Carey Law School provides a superior legal education through cross-disciplinary studies and our deserved reputation as a congenial and stimulating environment.

feeds.title: Texas Tech Law Library
feeds.description: Texas Tech Law Library provides resources on New book releases, Bloomberg law, West academic study aids, Research guide series, and more. Texas Tech Law Library and Academic Technology provide superior customer experience through leadership, innovation, service, and teamwork.

feeds.title: RIPS Law Librarian Blog
feeds.description: Covering trends in research, instruction, and patron services within today's law libraries. One can find articles on legal research instruction, patron services, information literacy, and more. The RIPS Law Librarian Blog is published by the Research, Instruction, and Patron Services Special Interest Section (RIPS-SIS) of the American Association of Law Libraries.

feeds.title: Jenkins Law Library Blog
feeds.description: Explore Jenkins Law Library Blog for the latest news, updates, and resources about Law matters. Jenkins Law Library has been providing information and legal research for the Pennsylvania legal community for more than 200 years. The Law Library Company of the City of Philadelphia was formed by a group of lawyers who set out to provide legal information for the growing law community in the City.

feeds.title: National Indian Law Library
feeds.description: A blog covering current events in federal and tribal American Indian Law. The National Indian Law Library (NILL) is a law library devoted to American Indian law. The Library serves the research needs of the Native American Rights Fund (NARF) (the oldest and largest nonprofit law firm specializing in Indian law) as well as the public. NILL provides specialized Indian law research assistance and maintains a unique and valuable collection of Indian law resources.

feeds.title: Harris County Robert W. Hainsworth Law Library » Ex Libris Juris
feeds.description: A public law library that serves the legal information needs of self-represented litigants, legal professionals, judges, and governmental officials. The Harris County Robert W. Hainsworth Law Library's mission is to provide all of its patrons access to relevant, current, accurate, and practical legal information in the most appropriate and cost-effective formats possible.

feeds.title: Squire Law Library News
feeds.description: The Squire Law Library is fully committed to a proactive and inclusive approach to equality, which supports and encourages all under-represented groups, promotes an inclusive culture, and values diversity. The Squire aims to support and underpin the teaching and research activities of the students and researchers associated with the Cambridge Faculty of Law.

feeds.title: Canadian Association of Law Libraries Blog
feeds.description: Read the latest articles, news, and information about the latest law library book collection on the CALL blog. CALL is dedicated to promoting the networking, professional development, and career growth of all law librarians in Canada, no matter where they work. We are committed to promoting law librarianship, developing and increasing the usefulness of Canadian law libraries and fostering a spirit of cooperation among them, providing a forum for meetings of persons engaged in or interested in law library work

feeds.title: San Diego Law Library
feeds.description: The San Diego Law Library is your access point for legal information. You will find resources to help you navigate your court case and other legal issues you experience in your life on topics like law & comics, family law, border law, and more. The San Diego Law Library will become everyone's first choice for finding legal solutions, pursuing access to justice, using advanced technology, and learning how the law works for them.

feeds.title: The Great Library Blog
feeds.description: The aim of our blog is to share legal research know-how. You'll find practical research tips, as well as posts highlighting library resources, both print and electronic.The Great Library serves the legal information needs of Law Society of Ontario licensees and other legal researchers by facilitating access to an extensive collection of electronic and print resources, and by providing legal research assistance and instruction.

feeds.title: LibraryCanuck
feeds.description: Alan Kilpatrick is innovative information professional with experience in legal, government, and academic libraries.With a proven ability to build relationships and collaborate with a broad range of stakeholders, he skillfully brings together information services, resources, and expertise to add value to his clients. He brings a wealth of fresh ideas and energy to information services. Alan is a Co-Director & Law Librarian with the Law Society of Saskatchewan's Legal Resources Department.

feeds.title: Nahum Gelber Law Library Blog
feeds.description: This blog is maintained by Svetlana Kochkina, a liaison librarian at the Nahum Gelber Law Library. Its main purpose is to offer an additional communication channel between the author and the law school students and to allow easier and faster sharing of information, legal research tools and tips, resources, and collections.

feeds.title: Criminal Law Library Blog
feeds.description: The library has online legal material. This includes cases, statutes and legal treatises. Most of this material covers New York State Law with an emphasis on Landlord Tenant Law, Family Law, Criminal Law and Civil Procedure. The Public Access Law Library seeks to provide a comfortable environment where a broad base of patrons are given the ability to obtain legal and related information in an easily accessible manner and format.

feeds.title: Barco 3.0 : Law Library Reference
feeds.description: Helpful information, news, stories, and updates related to law, and judiciary from the librarians of the Barco Law Library for attorneys, and law students. Barco Law Library is part of the University of Pittsburgh School of Law.

feeds.title: Law Library Blog
feeds.description: The Law Library is an academic, research library with the primary goal of supporting the work of the faculty and students of the School of Law and the University. The Law Library also actively serves the University community, the government, the South Carolina bar, and the citizens of this state. The Law Library's collections encompass American law, the legal history of South Carolina, and foreign, international, and comparative law.

feeds.title: Library Boy
feeds.description: Hi, I am Michel-Adrien the founder of Library boy which is legal research news from an Ottawa law librarian. On Library boy one can find articles, news, and information related to Canadas law related issues, and legal issues in different industries. and more.

feeds.title: 3 Geeks and a Law Blog
feeds.description: A law blog addressing the foci of 3 intrepid law geeks, specializing in their respective fields of knowledge management, internet marketing, and library sciences, melding together to form the Dynamic Trio. This blog may seem somewhat eclectic, but if you step back you can see that we focus on the administrative side of today's large law firm environment, plus Toby and Casey write regularly about in-house and the corporate sector.

feeds.title: Gallagher Blogs
feeds.description: Library news and legal research tips from the Marian Gould The Gallagher Law Library serves the University of Washington School of Law, the larger UW community, and the public. We have created legal research guides on a number of common topics, such as researching case law, statutes, and secondary sources. Research guides are lists of librarian-recommended resources on your specific topic, and are an excellent starting point for any legal research project.

feeds.title: Oregon Legal Research Blog
feeds.description: Read articles on Law Practice & Management, General Legal Research, Legal News & Commentary, and more on Oregon Legal Research Blog. Oregon public law librarians, and this website, serve many people: litigants, attorneys, judges, law firm and self-employed law librarians, investigators, elected officials, state, local, and federal government employees, legal researchers and writers, teachers, reporters, law students, and paralegal students.

feeds.title: Elon Law Library
feeds.description: The Elon Law Library seeks to contribute to the School of Law's mission to graduate exceptionally educated, well-motivated, technologically savvy, internationally aware, and effective lawyer leaders. We collect and organize information, materials, and media relevant to the study and practice of law with Elon's commitment to leadership, global awareness, and ethics always in mind.

feeds.title: Slaw » Legal Information
feeds.description: Slaw is Canadian, cooperative, and about any and all things legal. Since 2005, Slaw.ca has been Canada's online legal magazine, written by and for the Canadian law community: lawyers, librarians, technologists, marketers, students, educators, and everyone in between. Slaw explores how the law is practiced, how it's taught, how the industry is changing, and what the future might hold.

feeds.title: The Ross-Blakley Law Library Blog
feeds.description: The Ross-Blakley Law Library Blog aims to keep you up-to-date on the services we provide as well as a way to inform the College of Law community about key legal education, research, practice, and law-library news. The John J. Ross-William C. Blakley Law Library serves the students, faculty, and staff of the Sandra Day O'Connor College of Law at Arizona State University.

feeds.title: The Harvard Law School » Amicus Libris
feeds.description: Et Seq. communicates information about the library and legal resources and news to Harvard Law School faculty, students, staff, and other interested readers. Visit Et Seq. for library announcements and the latest on cool new technologies, new books, journals and e-resources, new resources from foreign jurisdictions, interesting current events, hot documents, and more.

feeds.title: Hofstra Law Library Blog
feeds.description: The Law Library is an integral part of Hofstra Law. The Library's primary goal is to support the curriculum and research needs of our faculty and students.Its print and electronic holdings include statutes, codes and case law for all state and federal jurisdictions; a comprehensive collection of English language legal periodicals; treatises; encyclopedias; digests; citators; looseleaf services; comparative and international legal materials; and selected foreign legal materials.

feeds.title: Ramsey County Law Library Blog
feeds.description: Ramsey County Law Library Blog provides the best legal information services to its patrons. Ramsey County Law Library blog features articles related to law books, Court cases, and more.

feeds.title: Riverside County Law Library Blog
feeds.description: Read news, and updates information about any issues related to Law, Judiciary, and more on Riverside County Law Library Blog. The Riverside County Law Library is the only public law library in the County. The Law Library provides free access to the current collection of legal materials, highly skilled and knowledgeable staff, free public education programs, as well as quality continuing legal education classes.
